red_blue.label: Red / Blue
useful_notes: Strong early matchup against Brock and Misty.
Learns status moves that help catch wild Pokemon.
Struggles more against Flying, Fire, Psychic and Ice threats.

yellow.label: Yellow
yellow.availability: Gift in Cerulean City after Pikachu is happy enough.
useful_notes: Great support choice after the early game.
Sleep Powder and Leech Seed are useful in longer fights.
Arrives after Brock, so it does not solve the first gym immediately.

ruby_sapphire_emerald.label: Ruby / Sapphire / Emerald
ruby_sapphire_emerald.availability: Not normally available in Hoenn without trade or event transfer.
useful_notes: If traded in, it works best as a status and sustain Pokemon.
Abilities exist in this generation, so check the ability before planning.
Its Grass typing is useful against Water, Ground and Rock Pokemon.
